routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of dozens of countries can enter without a visa. Most get up to 30 days. Some neighbors get up to 90 days.

other: The official MFA table lists most visa-free countries (US, UK, Germany, Japan, China, most EU states and more) at up to 30 days.
Up to 90 days: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Mongolia, Russia, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, Uzbekistan and a few others.
India, Iran, Hong Kong and Macao get 14 days.
Check your exact passport on the linked MFA list. Some rows in the table look inconsistent.

stay.note: 30 days per entry for most. One embassy page says total stay is capped at 90 days in any 180 days for the standard list.

routes.name: QazETA electronic entry authorization
routes.summary: A free online entry permit for visa-free travelers. It is being phased in and becomes mandatory on July 1, 2027. Until then it is voluntary.

other: Applies to citizens of visa-free countries, including EAEU states.
Exempt groups reportedly include children under 16, people 65+, and holders of Kazakh visas or residence permits.
Reported details: free, valid 180 days, multiple entries, apply at least 72 hours before arrival at qazeta.kz.
These details come from press reports. The official portal qazeta.kz blocked our fetch, so confirm there before relying on them.

stay.note: Reported 180-day validity of the authorization, not the length of stay.

steps: Apply online at qazeta.kz at least 72 hours before travel.
Carry the same passport to the border.

sources.label: MFA: visa regime for foreign citizens (visa-free list QazETA applies to)

routes.name: Tourist and business visas (B12, B1, B3, B10)
routes.summary: Single-entry visas for people who are not visa-free. Citizens of 48 listed countries can get them without an invitation letter. Others need an invitation through a Kazakh immigration agency.

other: No invitation needed for the 48 listed countries: tourist B12 (30 days), business B1 (60 days), business B3 (30 days), private B10 (90 days).
Everyone else needs a formal invitation letter. Fees not confirmed on the page.

routes.name: Neo Nomad Visa (B12-1)
routes.summary: Multiple-entry visa for remote workers with foreign income. Valid up to 1 year and can be extended once for 1 more year. It does not allow working for Kazakh employers.

income.note: About 3,000 USD. Shown by 6 months of bank statements.

other: Remote work with permanent income from foreign sources.
Citizens of 48 listed countries need no invitation letter. Others need one.
Needs tax return, criminal record certificate, and medical insurance for the whole stay.
Fee and appointment details below are from the London consulate page. Fees may differ by mission.

stay.note: Extend up to 1 more year via the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

steps: Book an appointment at a Kazakh consulate.
Collect the visa after about 5 business days.
documents: Passport with 2 blank pages, valid 3+ months beyond visa
routes.processing: About 5 business days at the London consulate after documents are received.

routes.name: Kandas status (ethnic Kazakh returnees)
routes.summary: A 1-year status for ethnic Kazakhs moving to Kazakhstan. A commission approves it. It is the gateway to permanent residence and simplified citizenship.

other: For ethnic Kazakhs only.
A commission decides. Grounds include moving to a designated region, family reunification with Kazakh citizens, an employer invitation, or study at a Kazakh university.
Apply online at migration.enbek.kz or through Kazakh missions abroad.

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Issued by Migration Service departments of the Interior Ministry. The official page we could open only details the kandas route. Rules for other foreigners are in the Law on Population Migration.

other: Kandas route: needs a kandas certificate and IIN. Decision within 60 calendar days.
Needs passport valid over 180 days, medical certificate, and housing documents.
Routes and years for non-kandas foreigners (including work, family, investor) were not confirmed. Check the Law On Population Migration and Rules.

sources.label: Government portal: how to obtain a residence permit

routes.name: Citizenship by simplified registration (kandas)
routes.summary: Kandas who live legally in Kazakhstan can apply through simplified registration with the local Police Department. Decision is due within three months.

other: Ethnic Kazakh with kandas status.
No minimum residence period stated on the page.
General naturalization rules, language test and dual citizenship were not confirmed. Kazakhstan is widely known to restrict dual citizenship, but we have no official page read to cite.

citizenship.note: Simplified route for kandas. Dual citizenship rules not confirmed.
